manufacturer: onsemi (Littelfuse, Vishay also make SMBJ family)

pinout.notes: Bidirectional 'CA' part: two junctions in series back-to-back, polarity-independent.

verification_notes: VRRM, VBR, VC, PP verified. 'CA' suffix = bidirectional; 'A' suffix (unidirectional) has a different part number.
replacement_notes: TVS replacement MUST match VRRM (>= the rail's normal max), VC (<= the protected IC's abs max), and PP (>= expected surge). A higher-VC TVS does NOT protect; a lower-VC TVS will false-clamp.
